subject: AWS ACE intake — marketplace listing & PDM/PSM onboarding (Orbit Analytics)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@amazon.com>, Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS ACE intake — marketplace listing & PDM/PSM onboarding (Orbit Analytics)

Hi Sonia / Maria,

Thanks for taking this on. Orbit Analytics is interested in listing on AWS Marketplace and pursuing the ACE co-sell path. Quick intro: Redwood Inference provides a hosted inference API + dedicated/private deployments; Orbit plans to integrate our hosted offering into their analytics product for enterprise customers.

Goal for this thread: complete ACE registration + get PDM/PSM introductions so we can align on account ownership, co-sell motions, and an initial GTM checklist (listing, procurement path, demo, and initial joint outreach).

Attachments: marketplace-intake-checklist.pdf (our recommended ACE checklist), product-one-pager.pdf. I'll paste the high-level asks below to keep things actionable.

High-level asks:
- AWS: confirm ACE registration next steps and who the PDM/PSM will be for Orbit (contact + estimated timeline).
- Orbit: confirm procurement contact and ideal timing for marketplace listing (Q4/Q1).
- Redwood: provide a brief demo recording and 3-5 customer use cases for the listing page + any required procurement templates.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sonia to confirm PDM/PSM and share ACE registration link/owner for the pull-through.
2) Schedule a 30-min alignment meeting (PDM + PSM + Orbit + Redwood) next week — suggested windows below.
3) Orbit to share procurement contact and any marketplace-specific requirements.

Suggested meeting windows (PT): 2027-10-06 10:00–12:00, 2027-10-07 14:00–16:00.

Maria — feel free to add or correct anything.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: marketplace-intake-checklist.pdf, product-one-pager.pdf
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@amazon.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS ACE intake — marketplace listing & PDM/PSM onboarding (Orbit Analytics)

Hi Jonas / Maria — thanks for the note and the checklist, very helpful. Quick answers from the AWS side:

- ACE registration: please complete the ACE registration form (link below). Once submitted, the AM team will assign a PDM and we typically have a PSM assigned within 3–5 business days depending on region and load.
- PDM/PSM assignment: I'll request Orbit be paired with our Enterprise PDM (North America) and an Attach PSM for marketplace enablement. I'll confirm names by EOD tomorrow.

ACE registration link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/ace-registration

A couple of notes on listing timing: if Orbit is aiming for a Q4 listing, we should prioritize the product metadata (pricing, usage model), required security attestations, and a minimal set of SKUs for launch. The AWS team also likes seeing a short demo video and 1–2 customer success bullets on the product page.

I'll follow up with the PDM/PSM names and propose a joint 30-minute kickoff slot once they're assigned.

Regards,
Sonia Patel
Sr. Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
Amazon Web Services
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@amazon.com>, Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-06T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS ACE intake — marketplace listing & PDM/PSM onboarding (Orbit Analytics)

Perfect — thanks Sonia.

Orbit / Maria — we can have a 6-minute demo recording ready by EOD tomorrow and a short 1-page security bulleted sheet with SOC2/retention notes by Friday. Karthik and Laura are looping in procurement templates and the proposed SKU matrix. Attached is a draft procurement terms doc (procurement-terms-draft.docx) that Orbit can comment on.

Proposed kickoff times (PT) — aiming for the week of 10/11 so PDM/PSM can join:
- 2027-10-12 09:00–09:30
- 2027-10-12 11:00–11:30
- 2027-10-13 13:00–13:30

If those don't work, tell us your best availability and we'll adjust.

Thanks — Jonas
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@amazon.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS ACE intake — marketplace listing & PDM/PSM onboarding (Orbit Analytics)

Thanks, Jonas / Sonia.

Orbit is excited to move forward — Q4 works for us for a soft listing. Procurement contact is procurement@orbitanalytics.com (cc'd). A few notes from our side:
- We already have a reseller agreement with a regional GSI, so we need to confirm how that maps to marketplace SKUs and fulfillment.
- Procurement is comfortable with a 30-day trial SKU and usage-based pricing model; we'll finalize numbers internally this week.
- We'll review the procurement-terms-draft.docx and get comments back by 10/11.

We can make 10/12 11:00 PT work for the kickoff — please send a calendar invite once PDM/PSM are confirmed.

—Maria
VP, Partnerships & GTM
Orbit Analytics

Attachment: legal-contact-v1.pdf (contact details for procurement lead)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@orbitanalytics.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS ACE intake — marketplace listing & PDM/PSM onboarding (Orbit Analytics)

Thanks everyone — quick mutual action plan before we kick off: 

Redwood (Laura / Karthik / Jonas) — by 10/13:
- Deliver 6-min demo recording (link above).
- Provide 1-page security & data handling bullet sheet (SOC2, retention, keys).
- Draft SKU matrix and sample pricing for a trial + consumption model.

Orbit (Maria + procurement) — by 10/11:
- Confirm procurement comments on procurement-terms-draft.docx.
- Share finalized SKU preferences and whether reseller GSI needs to be referenced on the listing.

AWS (Sonia / assigned PDM/PSM) — by 10/11:
- Confirm assigned PDM & PSM names and join time for 10/12 11:00 PT.
- Share any mandatory marketplace metadata templates we should complete ahead of the meeting.

I'll send a short calendar invite for 10/12 11:00 PT and attach a meeting agenda. If anyone needs to escalate timing for a Q4 launch, flag it now.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
